mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, ORG_CODE, CREATE_TIME FROM EXT_USER_ORG WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.ID AS id, o.ORG_CODE AS org_code, o.ORG_NAME AS org_name, o.ORG_LEVEL AS org_level, o.P_ID AS p_id, o.ORGAN_STATE AS organ_state, o.ADM_DIVISION_CODE AS adm_division_code, o.ADM_DIVISION_NAME AS adm_division_name, o.CREATE_TIME AS create_time, o.CREATE_USER AS create_user FROM EXT_ORG_INFO o INNER JOIN EXT_USER_ORG uo ON o.ORG_CODE = uo.ORG_CODE WHERE uo.USER_ID = #{userId} AND o.ORGAN_STATE = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PT_USER u INNER JOIN EXT_USER_ORG uo ON u.USER_ID = uo.USER_ID WHERE uo.ORG_CODE = #{orgCode}
AND (u.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.USERNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.USERCHNNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
